children: Bar Harbor Bankshares made its Q2 2026 investor presentation available, highlighting $4.7B in assets and a 3.61% net interest margin.
Published Q2 2026 investor presentation for meetings on Sept 22–23, 2026; filing furnished as Exhibit 99.1.
Reported $4.7B assets, $3.9B deposits, $3.6B gross loans and a 3.61% net interest margin (Q2 2026).
Core ROAA annualized 1.33% and core ROATCE annualized 16.31%; efficiency ratio 55.8%.
Strong asset quality: NPAs 0.44% of assets, non-accruing loans down to 0.32% of total loans in Q2.
Deposit funding stable with $3.9B total deposits; cost of deposits 1.55% and available same-day liquidity ~ $1.3B.
